# Delaware Corporate Registry Lookup: Entities & Agents

Search the **Delaware Division of Corporations'** free public entity database by company name or file number and get a complete, ready-to-use record for each match: file number, legal name, entity kind and type, residency, formation date and state, and the registered agent's name, address and phone. No login, account or API key is required.

Delaware is where most U.S. companies and funds are formed, so this is the first stop for due diligence, KYC, counterparty checks, registered-agent research and company-name availability checks.

## What this actor does

- **Three modes:** search by one or more entity names, look up exact file numbers, or do both in a single run.
- **Batch names and numbers:** `entityNames` and `fileNumbers` accept lists, so dozens of lookups share one run. Records are de-duplicated by file number.
- **Past Delaware's 50-result window:** the free search shows at most 50 matches per name and then refuses to page. With `expandBroadSearches` on, a broad name is automatically split into alphabetical prefixes (for example `AMAZON` into `AMAZONA`, `AMAZONB`, … and a space-prefix bucket for names like `AMAZON ACE`) until every reachable match is collected or `maxItems` is reached.
- **Post-filters:** narrow the result set by entity kind, entity type, Domestic/Foreign residency, state of formation, formation-date range, and registered-agent name. Filters are applied to the full detail record, so they work even though the source has no server-side filter fields.
- **Exact-name lookup:** `exactMatch` switches from the source's default "starts with" matching to a complete legal-name match, using the Delaware form's own documented quotation-mark syntax.
- **Full registered-agent record:** name, street address, city, county, state, ZIP and phone whenever the Division has them on file.
- **Traceability:** every row records the `searchQuery`, its `searchRank` in that query's result list, and whether it was found by name or file number.
- **Omit-empty output:** fields the source does not have for an entity are left out rather than sent as `null`.

## Modes

| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| `searchByName` | Searches each value in `entityNames` using Delaware's own "starts with" matching (or exact matching with `exactMatch`). |
| `byFileNumber` | Looks up each value in `fileNumbers` and returns that entity's detail record. |
| `both` | Runs the name searches and the file-number lookups in one job. |

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | select | `searchByName` | `searchByName`, `byFileNumber` or `both`. |
| `entityNames` | string list | `["AMAZON"]` | One or more company names. Case-insensitive. Used by `searchByName` and `both`. |
| `exactMatch` | boolean | `false` | On: only the complete legal name; off: the source's "starts with" match. |
| `fileNumbers` | string list | – | Exact Delaware file numbers. Used by `byFileNumber` and `both`. |
| `expandBroadSearches` | boolean | `true` | Split a name that hits the source's 50-result cap into prefixes so later matches are still reachable. |
| `entityKinds` | multi-select | – | Keep only these entity kinds (Corporation, LLC, LP, Statutory Trust, Partnership, Registered Series, …). |
| `entityTypes` | multi-select | – | Keep only these entity types (General, Bank, Benefit Corporation, Exempt, Series, …). |
| `residency` | select | `any` | `any`, `Domestic` or `Foreign`. |
| `stateOfFormation` | text | – | Keep entities whose formation state equals this value (e.g. `DELAWARE`). |
| `formationDateFrom` | date | – | Keep entities formed on or after this `YYYY-MM-DD` date. |
| `formationDateTo` | date | – | Keep entities formed on or before this `YYYY-MM-DD` date. |
| `registeredAgentContains` | text | – | Keep entities whose registered-agent name contains this text. |
| `proxyConfiguration` | proxy | AUTO | Optional. The actor defaults to Apify's free datacenter group and only escalates when Delaware rate-limits a request. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `5` | Hard cap on emitted records across the whole run (1–100). |

### Example: several names in one run

```json
{
  "mode": "searchByName",
  "entityNames": ["AMAZON WEB", "GOOGLE ACCESS", "STRIPE"],
  "maxItems": 10
}
```

### Example: exact legal name

```json
{
  "mode": "searchByName",
  "entityNames": ["AMAZON WEB SERVICES, INC."],
  "exactMatch": true,
  "maxItems": 1
}
```

### Example: file numbers with filters

```json
{
  "mode": "byFileNumber",
  "fileNumbers": ["4152954", "5804452"],
  "residency": "Domestic",
  "entityKinds": ["Corporation", "Limited Liability Company"]
}
```

### Example: broad search plus filters

```json
{
  "mode": "searchByName",
  "entityNames": ["GOLDMAN SACHS"],
  "expandBroadSearches": true,
  "entityKinds": ["Limited Partnership"],
  "formationDateFrom": "2000-01-01",
  "maxItems": 25
}
```

## Output per entity

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `fileNumber` | Delaware file number. |
| `entityName` | Current legal entity name. |
| `entityKind` | e.g. `Corporation`, `Limited Liability Company`, `Limited Partnership`, `Statutory Trust`. |
| `entityType` | e.g. `General`, `Exempt`, `Series`, `Benefit Corporation`. |
| `residency` | `Domestic` (formed in Delaware) or `Foreign` (formed elsewhere, registered in Delaware). |
| `stateOfFormation` | Formation state, e.g. `DELAWARE`. |
| `formationDate` | Formation date as `YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `registeredAgentName` | Registered agent's name. |
| `registeredAgentAddress` | Street address. |
| `registeredAgentCity` | City. |
| `registeredAgentCounty` | County. |
| `registeredAgentState` | State code. |
| `registeredAgentZip` | Postal code. |
| `registeredAgentPhone` | Phone number when on file. |
| `searchQuery` | The name or file number that produced the row. |
| `searchRank` | 1-based position in that query's result list. |
| `matchedBy` | `entityName` or `fileNumber`. |
| `sourceUrl` | The Division's public search page. |
| `recordType` | Always `entity`. |
| `scrapedAt` | UTC timestamp of the lookup. |

## Data Source & Usage Notes

**Read this before running a large job.**

- **Terms of Use caution.** The Delaware Division of Corporations' website Terms of Use caution against automated tools. This is a policy/contractual risk, not a login or paywall: the data is public and no account is needed. The actor is intended for light, occasional lookups. Please review the source site's terms and use it accordingly.
- **The site rate-limits automated traffic.** Rapid, repeated searches from one IP can trigger a disabled search button / CAPTCHA state. The actor spaces requests by several seconds, retries with a fresh proxy session on a detected block, and defaults to Apify's free datacenter proxy group.
- **50 results per name.** Delaware refuses to page past 50 matches for a single name search. `expandBroadSearches` works around this by partitioning the name into prefixes; a prefix that still has more than 50 matches is reported in the run's status message.
- **No per-entity URL.** The source uses form postbacks and has no bookmarkable entity page, so `sourceUrl` points to the public search form where the lookup can be reproduced.
- **Not affiliated with the State of Delaware.** This is an independent third-party tool.

## What is not included (and why)

- **Entity status, franchise tax and filing history.** The Division sells these as paid add-ons ($10 for status, $20 for status + tax/history). They are not part of the free entity search and are never scraped or guessed.
- **A per-entity permalink.** There is none on the free site; see above.
- **Server-side filters.** The free search form only accepts a name and a file number; all other filters in this actor are applied to the detail records after they are fetched.

## Legacy compatibility

Existing saved tasks that use the old single `entityName` input keep working: the actor maps that key onto `entityNames` in code, so old tasks and schedules return the same kind of data without edits. Likewise, `fileNumbers`, `exactMatch`, `proxyConfiguration` and `maxItems` keep their old meanings.

## FAQ

**What is the data source?** The Delaware Division of Corporations' free public entity search at `icis.corp.delaware.gov`. This actor is independent and not affiliated with the State of Delaware.

**Is this an official certificate or a statement of good standing?** No. It returns the same free-tier informational data the public search shows. For an official certificate or status document, use the state's paid ordering channels.

**Why does a broad name return only 50 rows?** That is Delaware's own per-search window. Turn on `expandBroadSearches` to have the actor split the name into prefixes and continue collecting beyond the first 50.

**Why do some rows not start with my name?** Delaware's search also returns token/fuzzy matches for some names (for example `THE AMAZON …` for `AMAZON B`). The actor re-checks each row against the documented "starts with" (or exact) contract and drops rows that do not match, so the output stays clean.

**Why did my run return zero results?** Either nothing matched, or the source rate-limited the run (see Data Source & Usage Notes). Try again later with a smaller `maxItems`.

**Can I look up many companies at once?** Yes. Put many names in `entityNames`, many numbers in `fileNumbers`, or use `mode: "both"`. Records are de-duplicated across all inputs.

**How fresh is the data?** Real time — the search reflects the Division's database at the moment of the lookup.

## Use cases

- **Due diligence** — confirm a counterparty's Delaware formation date, entity kind and registered agent.
- **KYC / AML** — match a legal name or file number to the official registry record.
- **Registered-agent research** — see which agent and address an entity uses.
- **Fund and deal research** — trace LPs, LLCs and corporations formed in Delaware.
- **Name availability** — see which similarly named entities already exist before choosing a new name.
